integrity: The complete matching-deletion formula is proved by a first-force shore-count obstruction and explicit forcing/dominating witnesses. The all-parameter theorem does not rely on finite experiment. The undeleted complete-bipartite case and known standard-graph boundaries are prior coverage.
scientific_limitations: No extension to arbitrary sets of removed edges is claimed.
Small-graph enumeration independently corroborates but does not replace the proof.
Previously known t=0 and isolated standard-graph cases are not claimed as separately novel.
Originality is a qualified best-of-knowledge judgment.
title: Dom-forcing under matching deletions in complete bipartite graphs
